title: Structural test of the Alcubierre warp family against the model's induced-gravity / beable-source commitments

G1_symbolic_negative_wall.note: rho<=0 everywhere, <0 where f'!=0 => WEC violated for the Eulerian observer (Alcubierre/Pfenning-Ford, exact in-repo)
G1_symbolic_negative_wall._desc: EXACT sympy: Alcubierre Eulerian rho = -(1/8pi)(v_s^2/4)(rho_cyl^2/r^2)f'^2 <0 (WEC violated)

G2_integrated_energy_negative.note: E(v_s) = -C v_s^2 < 0 for every v_s incl. subluminal; sign velocity-independent => M2 (F193) forbids the source
G2_integrated_energy_negative._desc: numeric: E(v_s)=-C v_s^2<0 for all v_s incl subluminal; M2 forbids source

PA1_kernel_carries_positive_source.note: M3: kernel carries positive/exotic stress (AB!=1) fine; obstruction is the source SIGN, not the kernel
PA1_kernel_carries_positive_source._desc: numeric/M3: F181 kernel carries positive source -> valid metric AB!=1, lapse well

PA3_momentum_cosupport.note: T^{0x} ∝ f'(r_s)^2 and rho<0 ∝ f'(r_s)^2 share support => cannot keep warp momentum flux while dropping the negative wall
PA3_momentum_cosupport._desc: numeric: momentum density and negative wall both ∝ f'^2 (co-supported)

PC1_speed_limit.note: M4: induced field well-posed (A,B>0), local propagation c_eff<=c_lat; warp ceiling = c_lat=1/sqrt3 (no FTL coordinate transport since the metric is induced, not free-standing)
PC1_speed_limit._desc: numeric/M4: induced field well-posed, c_eff<=c_lat; warp ceiling c_lat=1/sqrt3
